# `MC_grpGetScreenFrameBuffer`

Obtain the frame buffer handle for a display index.

## Prototype

```c
MC_GrpFrameBuffer MC_grpGetScreenFrameBuffer(M_Int32 i);
```

```{doxygenfunction} MC_grpGetScreenFrameBuffer
:project: libwipi
```

## Usage

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `i` | Display index. |

### Return value

The frame buffer handle for the selected display.

### Ownership

The display provider owns the returned screen frame buffer.
